venue.address: Via della Pace, 13, 95027 San Gregorio di Catania CT
venue.details: Ingresso dal cortile (ultimo cancello)/Entrance from the courtyard (last gate)

items.information: ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png) **WARNING**: please note that this competition does not hold the most popular events (2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, etc.). Check carefully if this is a kind of competition you would be able to participate in. The competition will take place in a limited space. You may bring at most only one guest per competitor. **Note: you will have to pay 10 € extra at the venue if you are not a Cubing Italy member.** Membership is free! More info in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PpiFauriAstutitiSicily2025#58662-registration-registrazione-faq). --- ![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) **ATTENZIONE**: si prega di notare che questa competizione non prevede gli eventi più popolari (2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, ecc.). Verifica attentamente se sei in grado di partecipare a questo tipo di competizione. La competizione si svolge in uno spazio limitato. È possibile portare al massimo un accompagnatore per partecipante. **Nota: dovrai pagare altri 10 € in loco se non sei un socio di Cubing Italy.** Associarsi è gratis! Scopri come nella [sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PpiFauriAstutitiSicily2025#58662-registration-registrazione-faq).

items.name: Surrey Monday Open 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e7429bea0d8a072b28438bc1328d960e54d128b9/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You are welcome to join the Facebook Group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule. You should be present for check-in and the tutorial, and may leave once you're done competing - but we encourage you to stay until awards. **Notice of filming and photography** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.
